activity_summary: At the end Richard said the lover is all haste, and that he is seven-and-twenty. You told him to play it at a run. Nick said he had marked the roll and had nothing to ask. Kemp's count is nine-and-twenty lines, a fan, and half a song he is not let finish. You asked him to keep Saturday supper free, for something that is not in this play. You stayed on you. Nothing was copied. This afternoon's Shrew is not you.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said play him at a run, and asked for Saturday without a page.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Named his age and the haste, and refused a new speech at the door.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Counted nine-and-twenty, and stayed on you.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Marked the roll, asked nothing, and left.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Kept the half song half, and kept the book shut.
